Theorem
[Pointed total boundedness criterion] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0418 1. appG:G.19\group Gromov compactness If every pointed ball $B(x_0,\rho )$ in a family admits an $\epsilon $-net of cardinality at most $N(\epsilon ,\rho )$, then the family is pointed Gromov--Hausdorff precompact.
